A couple of things about Heirloom that may help:

All of our roses are premium own-root plants grown at our nurseries in Oregon, not resold from third parties.
We grow them in 1-gallon containers in soil (not bare root), so you get a well-established plant.
Roses have a one-year guarantee, perennials 90 days, and bulbs a failure-to-bloom guarantee, because we stand behind the quality.
